name: Miguel De La Rosa
office: City of Bell Gardens, Member of the City Council

items.text: Miguel De La Rosa is mayor of Bell Gardens and a councilmember running for re-election. He was first elected in 2024 after chairing the city's Planning Commission from 2021 to 2024.

sentences.text: Miguel De La Rosa is mayor of Bell Gardens and a councilmember running for re-election.
He was first elected in 2024 after chairing the city's Planning Commission from 2021 to 2024.

items.text: De La Rosa urged voters to pass a 0.25-percentage-point sales tax increase to replace revenue lost from a blackjack ban that could cost the city about 40% of its general fund. In his 2024 campaign, he supported affordable housing, rent stabilization, rental assistance, and the construction of new low-income units. In June 2026, he voted to propose selling the municipal water system to Golden State Water Company and place the measure on the ballot.
